descriptionHtml:
AULA F108 Pro Tri-Mode Gasket Mechanical Keyboard (Full-Size 108 Keys Layout / Smart Display Screen / Multi-Function Knob / Hot-Swappable / White Edition / Dynamic RGB)

Experience absolute desktop layout perfection and comprehensive control with the AULA F108 Pro Tri-Mode Gasket Mechanical Keyboard (Knob Version), arriving in a clean premium White colorway at Turbo Computer Egypt. Featuring a full-size 108-key form factor profile that includes a complete numpad, this flagship mechanical keyboard integrates an interactive built-in Smart Display Screen alongside a Multi-Function Volume Knob framework for effortless setting adjustments. Engineered with a premium Gasket-Mounted structural architecture, it incorporates multi-layered sound-dampening foam matrix parameters to deliver a rich HIFI acoustic signature profile. The full Hot-Swappable PCB layout supports seamless customization across all 3-pin and 5-pin keycaps configurations. The F108 Pro White delivers peak wireless versatility with its high-performance Tri-Mode ecosystem layout—delivering ultra-low latency 2.4GHz wireless tracking, stable Bluetooth wireless execution, and reliable USB-C wired charging paths. Completely wrapped in a vibrant, customizable dynamic RGB illumination system matrix, this smart full-size keyboard framework provides the ultimate competitive advantage for gaming control and desktop management.
